category_a_business.overview: SkyWater Technology, Inc. is a U.S.-based, independent, pure-play semiconductor foundry. It provides foundational-node manufacturing, advanced technology development, and advanced packaging services. The company supports commercial and government customers requiring secure, domestic manufacturing, long product life cycles, and high reliability for various applications.
milestones: 1991: Minnesota fab established as a captive manufacturing facility by Cypress Semiconductor Corporation
2017: Became an independent company through acquisition by an affiliate of Oxbow Industries, LLC from Cypress
2021: Completed Initial Public Offering (IPO) and began trading on Nasdaq under 'SKYT'
category_a_business.business_model: SkyWater generates revenue by offering semiconductor manufacturing services, including foundry services, advanced technology development, and advanced packaging. It integrates production-scale manufacturing with technology development, enabling customers to transition specialized semiconductor technologies from development to volume production.
category_a_business.value_chain_position: Midstream + Provides manufacturing and packaging services for semiconductor devices.
products: Wafer manufacturing (analog, mixed-signal, MEMS, specialty CMOS)
channels: B2B (direct sales to commercial and government customers)
category_a_business.key_customers: Not explicitly stated, but serves diverse sectors including quantum computing, aerospace and defense, automotive, bio-health, and industrial.

wikipedia_summary: SkyWater Technology, Inc. is an American semiconductor engineering and fabrication foundry, based in Bloomington, Minnesota. It is the only US-owned pure-play silicon foundry.
